note: The English Promotions page lists three ICBC UnionPay promo tiles. Each tile and the View More UnionPay Promo link points at v.icbc.com.cn or marketing.unionpayintl.com, which are not in official_domains. This recipe reads only the official listing text. Do not set detail pages that would follow those off-domain hrefs. The announcement list is loaded from papi.icbc.com.cn (window.appConfig.papi.host in /Portal_Resources/Common/config.js) and is not covered by this recipe.
